yt_title: Sone Ki Lanka Pehle Ravan Ki Nahin Thi! Kuber Ko Kaise Mili? | Ramayan Bhaag 3 #shorts
yt_description:
Sone ki Lanka ka pehla raja kaun tha?
Vaishravan (Kuber) ka hazaar saal ka tap, Brahma ji ka vardaan aur Pushpak vimaan.
Agle bhaag mein: Rakshas kaise bane?

Aadhar: Valmiki Ramayan, Uttar kaand, sarg 3

#ramayan #valmikiramayan #kuber #lanka #pushpakvimaan #uttarkand #ravan #pushpakkatha
kya_aaya: Vishrava ke putra Vaishravan (Kuber) ka tap, Brahma ji se lokpal ka var aur Pushpak, aur pita ke kehne par Lanka ke raja bane.
